children: Fermi (FRM) and TensorWave amended their data center lease and services agreement
under the lease by a month to Oct. 31, 2026, the companies said Tuesday.

All other terms of the lease remain unchanged and in effect. The lease covers 222 megawatts of total facility power at Fermi's Project Matador campus and represents ~$6.5B in expected total revenue over its initial 15-year term.

The company continues to negotiate a guaranty of certain lease obligations with an investment-grade counterparty. Both parties extended the closing date to allow more time to finalize that guaranty and complete the remaining closing conditions.

"Our remaining work is to finalize the lease guaranty with our counterparty," said Fermi CEO Lee McIntire. "Those discussions are active, constructive, and progressing, and we look forward to closing and delivering Project Matador's first data center for TensorWave."

title: Fermi, TensorWave agree to extend closing date of lease by a month
